title: The Agent Loop
description: A minimal agent that uses only a shell tool to accomplish tasks

steps.content: Create a file called hello.ts that prints 'Hello, World!'
steps.annotation: User sends a task to the agent

steps.content: I'll create that file for you using the shell.
steps.annotation: The model decides to use its only tool: shell
Function call: the model emits a shell command in the Responses output

steps.content: Let me verify the file was created correctly.
steps.annotation: The loop continues: the model sees the result and decides the next action

steps.content: Done! I've created hello.ts with the print statement. You can run it with `npx tsx hello.ts`.
steps.annotation: No function_call items in the response -> loop breaks, agent responds to user
